title: Changing to an internal customer makes the work order internal
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, flagged as an Internal customer, with a Min shop supplies charge of $15.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click "Change Customer" on the customer card.
  3. Pick customer B.
  4. Confirm the change.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Change Customer window opens.

Step 3:

  • The window reads "Prices are removed; costs and hours are kept."
  • It adds "Shop supplies resets to [customer B's name]'s minimum ($15.00)."

Step 4:

  • The work order shows the "Internal" badge.
  • The labor line shows 2.0 hours and no price.
  • The menu offers no "Convert to No Charge".
  • "Shop supplies" reads $15.00.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S2-R7: “Changing the customer on a work order works as today (not offered on an invoiced or paid billable work order, as today, nor on a closed internal or no-charge work order, S2-R9); until then the classification follows the new customer: to an internal customer the work order becomes internal (prices removed, costs and hours kept, no Convert actions); to a regular customer from an internal one it becomes billable (lines priced as in S2-R6). A No Charge mark and its category survive a change to another regular customer; a no-charge work order moved to an internal customer becomes internal and loses its category. The Change Customer dialog says what will happen to the prices and, when the work order stays internal or no charge, adds "Shop supplies resets to [customer]'s minimum ($[amount])." (without 'See Financial Data' the sentence omits the amount).”
  • S10-R2: “The amount can be changed on the work order until it is closed, with the existing per-work-order shop supplies control. Any customer change while the work order stays internal or no charge, or converting to no charge, resets it to the customer's Min. Making the work order billable again drops the flat amount and applies the customer's or the location's shop supplies rule as on any billable work order.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “Change the customer on a work order | 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' | As today”
